replies.author: JDKL
replies.body:
The staff application denial reasons tell you why you were denied and why your application wasn't accepted instead. Maybe you could think more carefully about your app's denial reasons and then you may get an idea of what you need to improve on using the reasons.
Examples:
Lack of detail --> This means that you may have not included enough information in your staff application or you haven't elaborated your answers enough.
Sometimes they may not use your staff application completely and may refer back to your past in-game.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
I guess not up for senior standards means that the seniors voted that you don't get an interview. 
To elaborate, seniors vote on applications. If the majority votes for an interview, you'll get one. If the seniors vote against an interview, you application gets denied.
Don't quote me on that, but from what I see, there wasn't an application that was denied for not enough votes for an interview.
